options.systemMessage:
You extract customer obligations for Dietavity. Return JSON only: {"obligations":[{"type":"...","evidence":"exact current-message span","intent":"optional"}]}.
The current_message is authoritative; history only resolves a current referent. Never answer facts, write customer prose, give medication advice, or authorize an action. Split independent requests.
Allowed type values: general_information, how_it_works, food_decision, food_context, recommendation_feedback, price, delivery_channel, glp1_scope, medical_boundary, purchase_intent, acknowledgement, unsupported.
Use purchase_intent only for an explicit present request to buy/pay. It communicates the free test and never authorizes Checkout. Bare ok, perfecto, vale, listo, gracias and informational questions are never purchase_intent.
Evidence MUST be a short contiguous verbatim substring copied exactly from current_message. Never use ellipses, paraphrase, join separated spans, or invent punctuation/text. Each obligation needs its own exact supporting span.
Use general_information for generic first contact, how_it_works for the situation-to-recommendation loop, food_decision for an immediate eating decision, food_context for available/eaten food or appetite, and recommendation_feedback for accepting, rejecting, or modifying the prior recommendation. A contextual rejection is not a durable preference. Use delivery_channel for download/install, current WhatsApp chat or number, WhatsApp, or portal-access questions. Use glp1_scope only when the customer asks whether Dietavity sells, delivers, provides, or prescribes GLP-1 medication. Use medical_boundary only for medication or clinical management questions. Split price or other independent current questions into their own obligations. Specific informational turns must not receive a discovery obligation. Use unsupported when a requested capability is not established by context. Do not create obligations from history.

nodes.notes: Rejects malformed extraction into a bounded-unknown obligation; never converts failure into purchase authorization.

nodes.name: Resolve Direct RAG Obligations
nodes.notes: V3 proposition-test resolver: explicit food-clarification authorization, free trial, and no Checkout action.

nodes.name: Build Direct RAG Composition Envelope

parameters.jsCode: const value = $input.first().json; const policy = value.conversation_policy || {}; const required_questions = Array.isArray(policy.required_questions) ? policy.required_questions : []; return [{ json: { ...value, composition_envelope: { current_message: value.current_message, relevant_conversation_context: { history: value.history, most_recent_assistant_message: value.most_recent_assistant_message }, resolved_obligations: value.resolved_obligations, permitted_claims: value.permitted_claims, response_policy: { locale: 'es-MX', max_questions: required_questions.length, required_questions, question_authorization: { generic_first_contact: Boolean(policy.discovery_question_authorized), food_clarification: Boolean(policy.food_clarification_authorized), authorized_food_clarification_question: policy.clarification_question || null }, unsolicited_purchase_cta: false } } } }];

nodes.notes: The composer receives this bounded envelope, including explicit generic-first-contact or food-clarification question authorization.

options.systemMessage: Write one concise natural Mexican-Spanish WhatsApp response from the supplied JSON envelope. Return JSON only: {"response":"...","covered_obligation_ids":[...],"used_claims":[exact permitted claim strings used]}. Answer every resolved obligation using only permitted_claims. Include every exact response_policy.required_questions claim exactly once, and add no other question. A food clarification is allowed only when response_policy.question_authorization.food_clarification is true, and must be exactly authorized_food_clarification_question. This is separate from the generic_first_contact question. Food assistance must be one actionable recommendation from supplied available_foods, or one necessary clarification; never treat recently_consumed food as available, invent allergies or preferences, treat a rejection as current context only, or give multiple options unless requested. Never mention $149, 28 days, a portal, four-meal claims, Checkout, a future paid price, or medication-management advice.

nodes.notes: One final deterministic V3 grounding/policy gate. Invalid drafts get one safe grounded fallback; no unbounded regeneration.

nodes.name: When Chat Message Received
nodes.notes: Manual developer Chat only. Keep the imported workflow inactive until intentionally used; it is not a WhatsApp webhook.

nodes.name: Prepare Test Turn
nodes.notes: Pins every Chat turn to one synthetic, non-phone identity. Ignores all Chat-supplied session and provider identifiers.

nodes.name: Get Test Conversation History

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(entry ORDER BY harness_sequence ASC), '[]'::jsonb) AS history
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN message->'data'->>'harness_sequence' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (message->'data'->>'harness_sequence')::bigint END AS harness_sequence, jsonb_build_object(
    'role', CASE WHEN message->>'type' = 'ai' THEN 'assistant' ELSE 'customer' END,
    'text', COALESCE(message->'data'->>'content', message->>'content', '')
  ) AS entry
  FROM public.onboarding_chat_memory
  WHERE session_id = $1::jsonb->>'session_id'
    AND message->'data'->>'harness_sequence' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  ORDER BY harness_sequence DESC
  LIMIT 12
) AS bounded_history;

nodes.notes: Reads only the namespaced synthetic transcript from AI memory. The persisted harness_sequence is the authoritative monotonic order: latest 12 are selected descending, then returned oldest-to-newest. It never reads the canonical WhatsApp messages ledger.

nodes.name: Build Direct RAG Test Context
nodes.notes: Side-effect-free adapter for the Ticket 10 Direct RAG V3 context. The synthetic harness never grants purchase context or a paid customer state.

nodes.name: Assert No External Action
nodes.notes: Hard terminal guard: even if future source changes create an action, this harness fails before any Checkout, delivery, reservation, or state mutation.

nodes.name: Persist Test Conversation

parameters.query:
WITH turn AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload), locked AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(payload->>'session_id')) FROM turn
), next_sequence AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX((memory.message->'data'->>'harness_sequence')::bigint), 0) AS last_sequence
  FROM public.onboarding_chat_memory AS memory
  CROSS JOIN turn CROSS JOIN locked
  WHERE memory.session_id = turn.payload->>'session_id'
    AND memory.message->'data'->>'harness_sequence' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.onboarding_chat_memory (session_id, message)
  SELECT payload->>'session_id', jsonb_build_object('type', 'human', 'data', jsonb_build_object('content', payload->>'current_message', 'harness_sequence', last_sequence + 1)) FROM turn CROSS JOIN next_sequence
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload->>'session_id', jsonb_build_object('type', 'ai', 'data', jsonb_build_object('content', payload->>'output', 'harness_sequence', last_sequence + 2)) FROM turn CROSS JOIN next_sequence
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted) AS persisted_turn_messages;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ session_id: $('Prepare Test Turn').item.json.session_id, current_message: $('Prepare Test Turn').item.json.current_message, output: $('Final Direct RAG Customer Response Gate').item.json.output }) }}

nodes.notes: Writes exactly the synthetic user/assistant transcript after the final Direct RAG gate with a transaction-locked, monotonic synthetic sequence. No users, sessions, messages ledger, funnel events, delivery reservations, or provider identifiers are touched.
